text: How does online reselling actually work, and where could it take you? Let's map the path.
Reselling is simple. Buy an item for less than someone will pay, then sell it online for the difference.
Stage one: you buy from a vendor. Thrift stores, clearance racks, or local sellers. One item at a time, low risk.
Say you buy a jacket for ten dollars and sell it for forty. After fees and shipping, you keep about twenty.
Stage two: reinvest your profit into bulk orders. Buying in lots lowers your cost per item, and fills your store faster.
Stage three: marketing. Good photos, steady posting, and followers bring repeat buyers, so items sell faster.
Most resellers spend the first months learning, grow steadily by month six, and scale within the first year.
Recap: buy low, reinvest in bulk, build a following.
